About

Malmequer is a Berlin-based punk rock trio formed by Brazilian friends who found each other through their urge to make music while far from home. Sung in both English and Portuguese, their songs blend the personal with the political, exploring mental health, daily struggles, and the social issues that shape their worldview.

Each member brings a distinct musical background to the table: Nico originated in São Paulo’s heavy metal scene, Giovanna played in post-hardcore and metalcore groups, and Judy emerged from Rio de Janeiro’s punk circuit. This diverse foundation fuels a sound that is raw and fast, rooted in riot grrrl and pop punk, edged with hardcore intensity, and deeply grounded in their Brazilian roots.

Bassist Giovanna and guitarist Judy trade off lead vocals with raw, high-powered intensity, while Nico’s ferocious drumming powers the band from behind the kit. Beyond the speed and urgency, the genuine chemistry between the three is obvious from the very first chord.

On stage, Malmequer is explosive, loud, and full of energy. Since debuting in January 2025, they have torn through venues in Berlin as well as festival stages in Potsdam and Prague, sharing lineups with established Berlin underground acts like YEAHRS and ANTI-CORPOS, as well as fellow Brazilian punk outfits Refugiadas and Morcegula.

Their debut release, the Small Talk EP (three tracks, November 2025), is available across platforms, and the trio is already finalizing a second DIY release.

For fans ofBikini Kill, Lunachicks, L7, Dead Fish
